must: Use semantic color tokens from src/styles/tokens.css
Distinguish processing failures from legitimate missing-document outcomes
Keep operator actions explicit and provide actionable request errors
avoid: Automatically retrying failed claims without operator action

decisions.decision: Completed sessions with claim read failures use a warning treatment and FAILED status badge.
decisions.reason: Operators must not mistake partial technical failure for successful claim processing.

decisions.decision: REQUIRE_DOC is reserved for claims whose detail page loaded successfully but had no downloadable files.
decisions.reason: A portal navigation or rendering failure is not evidence that documents are missing.
